title: @hono/node-server: Backslash in the request path is parsed as a path separator, bypassing path-based access control at…
description: @hono/node-server improperly parses backslashes in request paths as path separators, allowing bypass of path-based access controls enforced by reverse proxies that do not normalize backslashes. This can cause requests intended to be blocked by a proxy to reach protected routes within the application.
